source.note: Only one CSS selector changed after app startup; backend/EJS unchanged. Served CSS verified against final Git commit. Browser screenshots are all after the fix.

environment.method: Native Windows Computer Use, Chrome DevTools Responsive mode. Viewport size is visible in each original full-window photo. Fit-to-window scales desktop display; CSS viewport remains1366x900. No image edits.

fixedFinding.actualBefore: On desktop horizontal scroll, later time headers painted over sticky Sân / giờ corner because th[scope=col] selector overrode its z-index.
fixedFinding.fix: Increase only corner z-index rule specificity from .owner-calendar-corner to th.owner-calendar-corner; keep z-index4.

npmTest.note: Executed on integrated main before the CSS-only selector correction; not represented as a rerun after that change.

limits: Chrome responsive emulation only; not a physical Android/iOS browser test.
No claim of cross-browser, screen-reader, realtime or performance acceptance.
Long and empty browser photos use default27Oct; their HTTP cases also ran against future30Oct. Normal browser photos use30Oct except explicit keyboard date tests.
CI status and PR Draft transition are verified separately after pushing this evidence.
privacy: Only synthetic fixture data and calendar/dashboard screenshots. No private manifest, password, cookie, CSRF value, receipt URL/token or real user data published.
